rationale: Merge Prospect Storage into GlidePath Power Solutions. Quinbrook identifies GlidePath as the manager-level portfolio company and Prospect as its operating project. Direct company evidence describes Prospect as a greenfield GlidePath development, while court and ERCOT records identify West Columbia Storage LLC as a wholly owned GlidePath subsidiary and the project as an operating 9.9 MW resource with a December 12, 2019 in-service date. Powin, Habitat, ERCOT and financing parties are not treated as owners. The project and SPV names and operating history are preserved on GlidePath.

companyFieldUpdates.description: GlidePath Power Solutions develops, owns and operates battery-energy-storage projects across U.S. power markets. Quinbrook acquired the platform in 2017 through the Quinbrook Low Carbon Power Fund and continues to list GlidePath as a portfolio company. Its operating projects include Byrd Ranch, a 50 MW/50 MWh Texas battery facility; Meyersdale, an 18 MW/12 MWh Pennsylvania facility; and Prospect Storage, a 9.9 MW/9.9 MWh West Columbia, Texas project developed by GlidePath from greenfield construction in June 2019 and placed in service on December 12, 2019 through West Columbia Storage LLC. These project and SPV identities are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later GlidePath sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.
